name: Industrial & Infrastructure Fund Investment Corporation
summary: Industrial and Infrastructure Fund Investment Corporation (IIF) stands as Japan's pioneering J-REIT, specializing in the ownership and management of industrial as well as infrastructure real estate within Japan. These assets are considered foundational to the nation's economy, and IIF foresees sustained demand for them over the medium to long term. Concerning its industrial property holdings, IIF aims to cultivate a varied portfolio, encompassing manufacturing facilities and cutting-edge research and development centers.
